EXERCISE:
Calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - that is, the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig and mouse.
```{r}
mouse <- sum(185, 55, 9, 60)
human <- sum(83, 180, 110, 57)
pig <- sum(157, 109, 45, 31)

print (paste("mouse =", mouse))
print (paste("human =", human))
print (paste("pig =", pig))
```
Species with higest total number of r.e. genes = human
